entities.name: Vilém Flusser
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vilém Flusser was a Czech-born Brazilian philosopher, writer and journalist, best known for his contributions to media studies, communication theory, and the philosophy of language. He lived for a long period in São Paulo and later in France, and his works are written in many different languages.
